record: Gothenburg Museum of Art institutional description
facts: The 1923 building by Arvid Bjerke and Sigfrid Ericson has seven tall arches in yellow brick, elevated on cut stone terracing. Later additions opened in 1968 and 1996.
The 1923 core remains largely intact and the later east and rear buildings were separate construction phases.

record: Gothenburg City ground elevation product description
facts: Original 0.5 metre elevation grid is computed from classified airborne laser measurements in RH 2000 and released CC0.
